title: How are Palaash Muchhal and his family doing after controversial split with Smriti Mandhana? Daisy Shah gives an update | Bollywood
text:
Daisy Shah heaps praise on Palaash Mucchal and his family
In a conversation with Filmygyan, Daisy, who is set to star in Palaash’s next directorial venture, spoke about her bond with him and said, “Palaash is very good as a person. In fact, I have met him a couple of times. Palak had done a song for Jai Ho, so I have known her since then. I frequently go to parties at Palak’s home for birthdays and Ganpati Pooja, and that’s how I met Palaash. That’s how I got to know that he is a music composer and a director.”
